command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/crush005-exactpath.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$ROOT"' EXIT
LIVE1="$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.sh"
LIVE2="$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.py"
LIVE3="$HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush.py"
LIVE4="$HOME/frankenstein-repo/CRUSH.md"
printf 'CRUSH005_BOUNDARY=REAL_LOCAL_HOST_AI_CORE_NODE_NOT_SANDBOXED\n'
sha256sum "$LIVE1" "$LIVE2" "$LIVE3" "$LIVE4" | tee "$ROOT/before"
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity "$ROOT/research" -- --quiet --single-branch --branch chatgpt-work/entityos-crush-omega-bootstrap-20260913
test "$(git -C "$ROOT/research" rev-parse HEAD)" = bbca92180f7d11b38b4679d39a1bb79db8918e60
git clone --quiet https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush.git "$ROOT/donor"
git -C "$ROOT/donor" checkout --quiet d333e04385f9e1d1523cea7b417cb5e8798a713a
rm -rf "$ROOT/donor/internal/omega"
cp -a "$ROOT/research/research_entity/coordination/entityos_crush_seed/internal/omega" "$ROOT/donor/internal/omega"
GO="$HOME/.cache/entityos-crush-validation/crush004-full-20260913T0740Z/go/bin/go"
if [ ! -x "$GO" ]; then
  curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.27.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz -o "$ROOT/go.tgz"
  printf '63d339f0da5ab53635a56f2490a7984dfe12dfcff22ad749f63edaf590168445  %s\n' "$ROOT/go.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
  tar -C "$ROOT" -xzf "$ROOT/go.tgz"
  GO="$ROOT/go/bin/go"
fi
"$GO" version
cd "$ROOT/donor"
"$GO" test ./internal/omega -count=1
sha256sum "$LIVE1" "$LIVE2" "$LIVE3" "$LIVE4" | tee "$ROOT/after"
cmp "$ROOT/before" "$ROOT/after"
printf 'CRUSH005_EXTERNAL_ROUTE_GO_TEST_PASS\nCRUSH005_LIVE_HARNESS_BYTE_INVARIANT_PASS\n'
